title: 店舗用アンテナゲート一対
description: 店舗入口に配置する二本一組のアンテナゲート外観。丸角の開口フレーム、内側ループカバー、支持橋、非発光の表示レンズ、ケーブル用サービス蓋、開口したケーブルグランド、床取付板と固定ボルトを造形。店舗、配線、商品タグや内部電子回路は含みません。検出、警報、防犯、通信や通行制御機能のない静的表示モデルで、設置基準・安全性・検出性能は未検証です。配置原点は一対全体の中心で、各固定穴の施工基準点ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.490 × 1.580 × 0.650 m、13,584三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A paired retail entrance antenna-gate appearance assembly with rounded open frames, inset loop covers, support bridges, unlit opaque status lenses, cable service lids, open cable glands, ground plates and mounting bolts. No shop, wiring, product tags or internal electronics is included. Static visualization with no detection, alarm, theft prevention, communications or access-control functionality; installation, safety and detection performance are unvalidated. The placement origin is centered on the complete pair, not an installation datum for individual mounting holes. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.490 × 1.580 × 0.650 m; 13,584 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
